### Health Analytics with R · Module 02: EDA in Healthcare
***
**Learning objectives**
- Join patient ZIP codes to census tracts using synthetic spatial data
- Compute age-adjusted hospitalisation rates and readmission rates by area
- Create choropleth maps with `sf` and ggplot2
- Overlay a social vulnerability index (SVI) and compute spatial correlations
- Export interactive maps with `leaflet`

**Estimated time:** 3 hours | **Level:** Advanced | **Libraries:** `dplyr` / tibble, sf, ggplot2, leaflet, `stats`

## 1. Setup & Dependency Check

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(sf)
library(leaflet)
library(scales)

mod02_dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "mod02")
dir.create(mod02_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

theme_health <- function(base_size = 12) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA)
    )
}
theme_set(theme_health())

cat(sprintf("sf %s available.\n", as.character(packageVersion("sf"))))
cat(sprintf("leaflet %s available.\n", as.character(packageVersion("leaflet"))))
```

## 2. Synthetic Geospatial Dataset — 50 ZIP Code Areas

```{r}
set.seed(42)

# ── Simulate 50 ZIP code areas (modelled on a mid-size US metropolitan area) ──
N_ZIPS <- 50

# Geographic centroids (roughly spanning a metro area, lat/lon)
lat_center <- 43.0
lon_center <- -76.1   # ~ Upstate NY
zip_df <- tibble(
  zip           = sprintf("%05d", 10000 + seq_len(N_ZIPS) - 1),
  tract_name    = sprintf("Tract %d", 100 + seq_len(N_ZIPS) - 1),
  lat           = runif(N_ZIPS, lat_center - 0.5, lat_center + 0.5),
  lon           = runif(N_ZIPS, lon_center - 0.5, lon_center + 0.5),
  population    = sample(3000:25000, N_ZIPS, replace = TRUE),
  pct_poverty   = rbeta(N_ZIPS, 2, 8) * 50,     # 0-50%
  pct_uninsured = rbeta(N_ZIPS, 1.5, 8) * 30,
  median_income = pmin(pmax(rnorm(N_ZIPS, 52000, 18000), 15000), 120000),
  svi_score     = rbeta(N_ZIPS, 2, 3),          # CDC SVI 0–1, higher=worse
  pct_elderly   = rbeta(N_ZIPS, 2, 6) * 40,     # % aged 65+
  urban_rural   = sample(c("Urban", "Suburban", "Rural"), N_ZIPS,
                         replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.50, 0.35, 0.15))
)

# Hospitalisations inversely correlated with income and SVI
zip_df$hosp_rate <- pmin(pmax(
  200
  + zip_df$svi_score * 180
  - zip_df$median_income / 1000 * 1.5
  + zip_df$pct_elderly * 4.5
  + rnorm(N_ZIPS, 0, 25),
  50), 600)

# Readmission rate
zip_df$readmit_rate <- pmin(pmax(
  12
  + zip_df$svi_score * 10
  + zip_df$pct_poverty * 0.18
  + rnorm(N_ZIPS, 0, 1.5),
  5), 35)

# Age-adjusted rate (add noise to crude to simulate adjustment)
zip_df$hosp_rate_adj <- pmin(pmax(
  zip_df$hosp_rate - zip_df$pct_elderly * 3.2 + rnorm(N_ZIPS, 0, 15),
  50), 600)

cat(sprintf("ZIP code dataset: %d x %d\n", nrow(zip_df), ncol(zip_df)))
print(head(zip_df))
```

## 3. Patient-to-ZIP Assignment & Aggregation

```{r}
# ── Generate patient discharge records with ZIP codes ─────────────────────────
set.seed(99)
N <- 800
# Assign patients to ZIPs weighted by population
zip_weights <- zip_df$population / sum(zip_df$population)
patient_zips <- sample(zip_df$zip, size = N, replace = TRUE, prob = zip_weights)

patients <- tibble(
  patient_id    = sprintf("PT-%05d", seq_len(N)),
  zip           = patient_zips,
  age           = as.integer(pmin(pmax(rnorm(N, 62, 16), 18), 95)),
  sex           = sample(c("M", "F"), N, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.48, 0.52)),
  los_days      = as.integer(pmin(pmax(rgamma(N, shape = 2.5, scale = 1.8), 1), 30)),
  readmitted_30 = rbinom(N, 1, 0.14),
  total_charge  = round(pmin(pmax(rgamma(N, shape = 2.5, scale = 1.8), 1), 30) * 2500, 2)
)

# Aggregate to ZIP level
zip_agg <- patients %>%
  group_by(zip) %>%
  summarise(
    n_discharges = n(),
    n_readmitted = sum(readmitted_30),
    mean_los     = mean(los_days),
    mean_charge  = mean(total_charge),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(observed_readmit_rate = n_readmitted / n_discharges * 100)

# Merge with ZIP reference table
zip_merged <- zip_df %>%
  left_join(zip_agg, by = "zip") %>%
  mutate(
    n_discharges = replace_na(n_discharges, 0),
    n_readmitted = replace_na(n_readmitted, 0)
  )
cat(sprintf("Merged ZIP dataset: %d x %d\n", nrow(zip_merged), ncol(zip_merged)))
cat(sprintf("ZIPs with ≥5 discharges: %d\n", sum(zip_merged$n_discharges >= 5)))
```

## 4. Scatter-Map Choropleth (sf + ggplot2)

```{r}
zip_sf <- st_as_sf(zip_merged, coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)

p_hosp <- ggplot(zip_sf) +
  geom_sf(aes(colour = hosp_rate_adj, size = population), alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_colour_distiller(palette = "YlOrRd", direction = 1,
                         name = "hosp rate adj") +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 10), name = "Population") +
  labs(title = "Age-adjusted hospitalisation rate (per 100,000 population)",
       x = "Longitude", y = "Latitude") +
  theme_health() +
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#F0F4F8", colour = NA))

p_read <- ggplot(zip_sf) +
  geom_sf(aes(colour = readmit_rate, size = population), alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_colour_distiller(palette = "Blues", direction = 1,
                         name = "readmit rate") +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 10), name = "Population") +
  labs(title = "30-day readmission rate (%)",
       x = "Longitude", y = "Latitude") +
  theme_health() +
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#F0F4F8", colour = NA))

p_geo <- p_hosp + p_read +
  plot_annotation(title = "Geographic distribution of health outcomes")
print(p_geo)
ggsave(file.path(mod02_dir, "geo_scatter_maps.png"), p_geo,
       width = 16, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

## 5. SVI Correlation Analysis

```{r}
# ── Pearson and Spearman correlations with SVI ────────────────────────────────
outcomes <- c("hosp_rate_adj", "readmit_rate", "mean_los", "mean_charge")
outcome_labels <- c("Adj. hosp. rate", "Readmit. rate (%)", "Mean LOS", "Mean charge ($)")

cat(sprintf("%-20s  %10s  %7s  %10s  %7s\n",
            "Outcome", "Pearson r", "p", "Spearman ρ", "p"))
cat(strrep("-", 65), "\n")
for (i in seq_along(outcomes)) {
  col <- outcomes[i]
  sub <- zip_merged %>% select(svi_score, all_of(col)) %>% drop_na()
  pr  <- cor.test(sub$svi_score, sub[[col]], method = "pearson")
  sr  <- cor.test(sub$svi_score, sub[[col]], method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)
  cat(sprintf("%-20s  %+10.3f  %7.4f  %+10.3f  %7.4f\n",
              outcome_labels[i], unname(pr$estimate), pr$p.value,
              unname(sr$estimate), sr$p.value))
}
```

```{r}
# ── Scatter plots: SVI vs health outcomes ────────────────────────────────────
color_urban <- c(Urban = "#2563EB", Suburban = "#16A34A", Rural = "#DC2626")

plot_svi <- function(metric, ylabel) {
  fit <- lm(zip_merged[[metric]] ~ zip_merged$svi_score)
  r   <- cor.test(zip_merged$svi_score, zip_merged[[metric]], use = "complete.obs")
  ggplot(zip_merged, aes(x = svi_score, y = .data[[metric]],
                         colour = urban_rural, size = population)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_abline(intercept = coef(fit)[1], slope = coef(fit)[2],
                colour = "black", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7) +
    annotate("label", x = 0.04, y = Inf, hjust = 0, vjust = 1.4,
             label = sprintf("r = %.2f, p = %.3f",
                             unname(r$estimate), r$p.value),
             size = 3.3, fill = "white", label.size = 0) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = color_urban, name = "Area type") +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 9), guide = "none") +
    labs(x = "Social Vulnerability Index (SVI)", y = ylabel,
         title = paste(ylabel, "vs SVI")) +
    theme_health()
}

p_svi <- plot_svi("hosp_rate_adj", "Age-adjusted hospitalisation rate") +
  plot_svi("readmit_rate", "30-day readmission rate (%)")
print(p_svi)
ggsave(file.path(mod02_dir, "svi_scatter.png"), p_svi,
       width = 13, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

## 6. Quintile Disparity Analysis

```{r}
# Stratify ZIP codes into SVI quintiles and compare outcomes
zip_merged <- zip_merged %>%
  mutate(svi_quintile = cut(
    svi_score,
    breaks = quantile(svi_score, probs = seq(0, 1, 0.2), na.rm = TRUE),
    labels = c("Q1 (Least)", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4", "Q5 (Most)"),
    include.lowest = TRUE
  ))

disparity_table <- zip_merged %>%
  group_by(svi_quintile) %>%
  summarise(
    n_zips          = n(),
    mean_population = mean(population),
    hosp_rate       = mean(hosp_rate_adj),
    readmit_rate    = mean(readmit_rate),
    pct_uninsured   = mean(pct_uninsured),
    median_income   = mean(median_income),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 1)))
cat("Health outcomes by SVI quintile:\n")
print(disparity_table)

ratio <- disparity_table$hosp_rate[nrow(disparity_table)] /
  disparity_table$hosp_rate[1]
cat(sprintf("\nDisparity ratio (Q5 vs Q1) for hospitalisation rate: %.2f×\n", ratio))
```

```{r}
# Bar chart of outcomes by SVI quintile
colors_q <- c("#2166ac", "#74add1", "#fee090", "#f46d43", "#a50026")

plot_q <- function(metric, ylabel) {
  ggplot(disparity_table, aes(x = svi_quintile, y = .data[[metric]], fill = svi_quintile)) +
    geom_col(colour = "white", show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.0f", .data[[metric]])), vjust = -0.3, size = 3.2) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors_q) +
    labs(x = "SVI quintile", y = ylabel, title = paste(ylabel, "by SVI quintile")) +
    theme_health() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 15, hjust = 1))
}

p_q <- plot_q("hosp_rate", "Adj. hosp. rate per 100k") +
  plot_q("readmit_rate", "Readmission rate (%)") +
  plot_annotation(title = "Health disparities across social vulnerability quintiles")
print(p_q)
ggsave(file.path(mod02_dir, "svi_quintile_bar.png"), p_q,
       width = 13, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

## 7. Leaflet Interactive Map

```{r}
pal <- colorNumeric("YlOrRd", domain = zip_merged$hosp_rate_adj)

m <- leaflet(zip_merged) %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) %>%
  setView(lng = lon_center, lat = lat_center, zoom = 10) %>%
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~lon, lat = ~lat,
    radius = ~pmax(4, n_discharges / 5),
    color = "white", weight = 0.5,
    fillColor = ~pal(hosp_rate_adj),
    fillOpacity = 0.8,
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<b>ZIP ", zip, "</b><br>",
      "Hosp rate: ", round(hosp_rate_adj), "<br>",
      "Readmit: ", sprintf("%.1f", readmit_rate), "%<br>",
      "SVI: ", sprintf("%.2f", svi_score), "<br>",
      "Discharges: ", as.integer(n_discharges)
    )
  ) %>%
  addLegend("bottomright", pal = pal, values = ~hosp_rate_adj,
            title = "Adj. hosp. rate")

htmlwidgets::saveWidget(m, file.path(mod02_dir, "health_disparities_map.html"),
                        selfcontained = TRUE)
cat("Interactive map saved:", file.path(mod02_dir, "health_disparities_map.html"), "\n")
cat("Open in browser to explore — hover over circles for ZIP-level details.\n")
m
```

## 8. Knowledge Check
1. Why do we use age-adjusted rates rather than crude rates when comparing hospitalisation across ZIP codes?
2. The SVI-hospitalisation Pearson r = +0.58. What does this tell you? What doesn't it tell you?
3. Why might rural areas show lower hospitalisation rates despite worse health outcomes (hint: access to care)?
4. What additional data source would you add to strengthen this analysis?
5. Re-run the disparity analysis stratified by urban/rural. Does the SVI gradient hold within each stratum?

```{r}
# Exercise 5 — SVI quintile disparity by urban/rural
for (urb in c("Urban", "Suburban", "Rural")) {
  sub <- zip_merged %>% filter(urban_rural == urb)
  if (nrow(sub) < 5) next
  nq <- min(5, max(2, floor(nrow(sub) / 2)))
  sub <- sub %>%
    mutate(q = ntile(svi_score, nq))
  tbl <- sub %>%
    group_by(q) %>%
    summarise(
      hosp_rate_adj = round(mean(hosp_rate_adj), 1),
      readmit_rate  = round(mean(readmit_rate), 1),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  cat(sprintf("\n%s — outcomes by SVI quintile:\n", urb))
  print(tbl)
}
```
